AnyEngineParts.Description: Engine parts and sound in one mod: turbochargers and belt-driven superchargers with blow-off valves, wastegate, antilag and launch control, oil ports, air filters, intercoolers, a Dyno sensor and a 1-4 rotor rotary engine; EngineSound's generated engine sounds; and the GPS Sensor part. Each piece can be switched off in Mod Settings. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.
